Messages.Author: Jon Stahler
Messages.Body:
Can you transfer retainers or equipment to a vampire who cannot have brought
them into play? It doesn't say that there are any consequences to this and
I've never read a ruling stating that the retainer/equipment wouldn't work
unless otherwise specified by card text. For example:

I bring a Raptor into play using a minion with Superior Animalism. If I tap
the Heidelburg to move it to a minion without superior animalism, is the
hand size effect in combat still applicable? I would think so as the card
was brought into play using the superior discipline. What if I tap the
Heidelburg to move the Raptor to a minion without Animalism? Will that
minion get +1 intercept with it if they attempt to block an action?

Thanks in advance.
